newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Qatar's Rasgas LNG exports on schedule for 1999.
newsitem.headline: Qatar's Rasgas LNG exports on schedule for 1999.

text.p: Qatar's Ras Laffan Liquefied Natural Gas Company Ltd (Rasgas) will land its first gas supplies from the giant North Field in March 1999, the company's managing director Neil Kelley said on Monday.
The landed gas will allow the first export of liquefied natural gas (LNG) from Rasgas -- the second of Qatar's multi-billion gas projects -- in July 1999.

"The bidding and commercial strategies employed by Rasgas have led to the timely execution of the engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contracts to complete the work and deliver the first shipment of Rasgas LNG by July 1999," Kelley said in a paper delivered at a gas conference in Abu Dhabi.
Rasgas, Qatar's second major LNG project, is 70 percent owned by the state Qatar General Petroleum Corp (QGPC) and 30 percent by U.S. Mobil Corp.

Gas will be produced from three well head platforms spread over a 100 sq km contract area in the offshore North Field, the largest non-associated gas field outside the former Soviet Union holding 300 trillion cubic feet of gas.
Project financing is expected to be finalised by the end of this year, Kelley said.

Rasgas has a firm sales and purchase agreement (SPA) with Korea Gas Corporation for the delivery of 2.4 million tonnes a year of LNG from mid 1999 to 2023 and negotiations are continuing to increase contract volumes.
"Rasgas has undertaken extensive marketing activities in Japan, Taiwan, China, Thailand, Turkey, India and other countries," Kelley said.
These talks are aimed at securing firm contracts to allow the project to have initially two trains to give the plant an annual capacity of five million tonnes.
The gas liquefaction plant as Ras Laffan is also designed to produce 45,000 barrels per day (bpd) of condensate and 312 tonnes of solid sulphur, Kelley said.
Exports from Qatar's first LNG project -- Qatar Liquefied Gas Company (Qatargas) -- will begin to Japan in December.
